verdict.rationale: Brevo's marketing pages document a drag-and-drop email editor and responsive, ready-made templates. Its API docs document per-recipient personalization through dynamic variables, so the core design-and-template workflow is present. Missing for 10: evidence of cross-client rendering or testing, evidence that personalization tokens work inside the visual editor (they are documented only for the transactional API), brand-kit or on-brand style controls, saving custom templates for reuse, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can design on-brand emails with a visual editor, reusable templates, and personalization tokens that render correctly across clients

citations.quote: Craft polished emails fast—just drag, drop, and send.
Jumpstart campaigns with responsive templates tailored to your industry and use case.
Skip the learning curve with ready-made templates
Personalize content for each recipient using dynamic variables.
